mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 25bps.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% over the same period, it signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST MoM increase > 5% and UNRATE MoM decrease > 0.2%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals stagflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% and CPIAUCSL MoM increase > 0.5%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both conditions are met.
